hard_constraints: Scene must be strictly solitary: only Ben Skywalker present in prose; no other characters appear or are referenced in dialogue.
Mara Jade Skywalker memory must be a single remembered pragmatic sentence only—no Force-ghost, mystical visitation, reassuring dream, or extended flashback.
Ben must not articulate the Skywalker-trap framework, Torin-pattern framework, or clinical trust problem in interiority.
Scene closes indefinitely on 'maybe a different solution'; no resolution or breakthrough.
Lightsaber rendered as physical weight/anchor only, not symbolic.
Use Star Wars Legends terminology: datapad (not laptop), no anachronistic terms like DNA/radio/sonar.
Force described experientially per force_mechanics: body-experience before analysis; no 'reached for the Force' repeats.
canon_risks: Ensure Mara's pragmatism aligns with Legends portrayal (ex-Imperial operative, spy/assassin turned Jedi; operational mindset from Legacy of the Force).
Gavran's resonance note must use era-specific vocabulary ('Weave-Resonance' or 'resonance' per terminology_registry; sparingly, earned by experience).
